description: This Java source file defines a singleton utility class 'GlobalNotificationBuilder' used for managing a global instance of 'NotificationCompat.Builder' in an Android application related to wear notifications. It provides static methods to set and retrieve the shared notification builder instance, facilitating notification updates across different components of the app.

classes.name: GlobalNotificationBuilder
classes.description: A singleton utility class that maintains a static instance of 'NotificationCompat.Builder' for global notification updates. It allows setting and retrieving this instance across different parts of the app to handle notification modifications without recreating builders.

methods.name: setNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Sets the static global NotificationCompat.Builder instance used for updating notifications.

methods.name: getNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current static global NotificationCompat.Builder instance.
